intent: Eight individual feelings tasks separate stated degrees, physical company, feeling subjects, advice and completed events without face-based inference.
picturePurpose: Original one-reader/two-reader garden comparison supports alone/company only; enjoyment and loneliness require written facts. A coded direction control represents less loneliness without invented measurements or a guaranteed cure.

workshop.title: 独处不等于孤独，建议不等于做到
workshop.instruction: 调变化方向、数读者，再核对感受者、动作和结果。

items.label: lonely：感受减轻，不等于不再独处
items.prompt: Set the feeling change, then keep what the message actually proves.
items.material: A friendly message made the new pupil less lonely.
items.before: A friendly message made the new pupil less
items.reason: lonely强调感到孤独，alone强调独处。less lonely只说明孤独感减轻，不等于彻底消失，也不证明身边一定多了人。made是make的过去式，这里记录友好消息带来的变化。
items.hint: 分开感受程度和有没有人陪伴。

wordDecision.prompt: Set the feeling change, then keep what the message actually proves.

shift.title: 友好消息带来怎样的变化
shift.hint: 只标感受变化的方向，不给实际程度编数值，也不推断身边有几个人。
shift.wrong: less lonely是孤独感减轻；不是不变或加重，也不是彻底消失或有人来到身边的证明。

options.text: All loneliness disappeared and could never return.
options.reason: less不是none，也不保证永远不会再有这种感受。

options.text: A visitor definitely arrived and sat beside the pupil.
options.reason: 收到消息不证明有人亲自来到身边。

options.text: The pupil felt less lonely; the sentence does not state who was physically nearby.
options.reason: less lonely是孤独感减轻，没有交代有没有人在身边。

items.label: alone：只辨一个人，不靠表情猜
items.prompt: The record says reading alone. Tap the view with one reader.
items.material: I enjoy reading alone in the garden.
items.reason: reading alone表示独自看书，不等于感到孤独。I enjoy明确说喜欢这种活动；图片只辨一人还是有人作伴，不能靠表情判断喜欢或难过。enjoy后用doing。

wordDecision.prompt: The record says reading alone. Tap the view with one reader.

art.alt: 同一花园长椅的两个对照画面：左侧只有一位学生看书，右侧有两位学生并排看书。

evidence.caption: A只有一位学生在读书，符合alone。喜欢由enjoy说明，不靠表情推断。
B有两位学生，不符合独自阅读；是否孤独不能只看人数。

options.text: B: two people are reading together on the bench.
options.reason: B有两位读者，不是alone。

options.text: A: one person is reading on the garden bench.
options.reason: A只有一位读者，符合alone；enjoy来自文字。

items.label: surprised：惊讶的是人，线索是大小
items.prompt: Keep who felt surprised and what surprised them.
items.material: We were surprised by the size of the nest.
items.after: by the size of the nest.
items.reason: be surprised by说明对……感到惊讶。surprised描述人的感受，surprising可描述令人惊讶的事物。the size只说大小，没有给具体尺寸，也不能直接改成一定很大。
items.hint: 感受者是we，by后找真正的线索。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep who felt surprised and what surprised them.

recordSelection.title: 不把size擅自写成巨大
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Surprised by size
rows.text: The nest’s size surprised the group.

rows.label: Exact huge measurement
rows.text: An exact measurement proves it was enormous.

rows.label: Bird species
rows.text: The bird species is the stated surprise.

recordSelection.hint: size只说大小，不带具体测量值。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Surprised by size；尺寸和鸟种都没有写。

options.text: The group felt surprised by the nest’s size.
options.reason: were surprised说明人的感受，by后是引起惊讶的大小。

options.text: The sentence gives an exact measurement and proves the nest was enormous.
options.reason: size没有给数值，也没明确说一定巨大。

options.text: The sentence identifies the bird species as the cause of surprise.
options.reason: 原句说size，不是鸟的种类。

items.label: relaxed：散步后的放松
items.prompt: Keep the relaxed feeling after the quiet walk.
items.material: I felt relaxed after a quiet walk.
items.reason: relaxed描述人的放松状态；relaxing可描述让人放松的活动。after a quiet walk说明散步后，不能补成已经睡着，也不能倒成散步前。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the relaxed feeling after the quiet walk.

recordSelection.title: 放松在散步之后
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Relaxed afterwards
rows.text: The speaker felt relaxed after the walk.

rows.label: Only beforehand
rows.text: The feeling only happened before the walk.

recordSelection.hint: 放松是已说出的感受；睡着没有依据。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Relaxed afterwards；不要补睡眠或倒置时间。

options.text: The sentence proves the speaker fell asleep.
options.reason: relaxed不等于asleep。

options.text: The feeling is only placed before the walk.
options.reason: after被改成了before。

options.text: The speaker felt relaxed after the quiet walk.
options.reason: after定位散步之后的感受。

items.label: calm：尽量保持，是建议
items.prompt: Keep the advice without claiming it has already succeeded.
items.material: Try to stay calm when the plan changes.
items.reason: try to do表示尽量做；stay calm中的calm是形容词，说明保持冷静。when给出计划改变时的情境。这是建议，不能据此认定已经做到，也不能说计划不会改。
items.hint: 先找Try，再分建议和已做到。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the advice without claiming it has already succeeded.

recordSelection.title: 建议不等于完成记录
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Advice to remain calm
rows.text: Try to remain calm when the plan changes.

rows.label: Already achieved
rows.text: The listener has definitely done it successfully.

rows.label: No plan changes
rows.text: The plan is guaranteed never to change.

recordSelection.hint: try说尽量，结果还需要实际记录。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Advice to remain calm；成功和不改计划都不是原句结论。

options.text: The sentence proves the listener has already stayed calm successfully.
options.reason: 建议不证明结果已经实现。

options.text: The listener is advised to try to remain calm when the plan changes.
options.reason: Try to提出建议，不是报告已经成功。

options.text: The sentence says the plan can never change.
options.reason: when the plan changes恰好保留计划改变的情境。

items.label: proud：自豪的对象是什么
items.prompt: Keep the object of pride without inventing who repaired it.
items.material: We are proud of our repaired garden bench.
items.reason: be proud of表示为……自豪。repaired作定语，说明长椅已经修好；our说明所属关系，不证明每个人亲手修理。别把对象、归属和动作执行者混为一谈。
items.hint: of后找对象，不给维修者补名字。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the object of pride without inventing who repaired it.

recordSelection.title: 保留长椅，不补维修者
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Proud of the repaired bench
rows.text: The group feels proud of its repaired bench.

rows.label: Everyone repaired it
rows.text: Every group member must have repaired it personally.

recordSelection.hint: our不等于每人亲手修过；repaired不能漏。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Proud of the repaired bench；另外两条补了执行者或否定修好。

options.text: The group feels proud of its repaired garden bench.
options.reason: of后是自豪的对象：修好的长椅。

options.text: The sentence proves every group member personally repaired the bench.
options.reason: our不证明每个人亲手修过，原句没指明维修者。

options.text: The bench is described as still broken and never repaired.
options.reason: repaired说明已修好，不是从未修理。

items.label: ashamed：为自己的嘲笑感到羞愧
items.prompt: Match the speaker’s shame with the speaker’s own action.
items.material: I felt ashamed of laughing at his mistake.
items.reason: be ashamed of doing表示为做了某事感到羞愧。I是感受者，laughing at his mistake是让自己羞愧的行为；his不是本句的感受者。laugh at表示嘲笑。
items.hint: 先找I，再核对是谁嘲笑了谁。

wordDecision.prompt: Match the speaker’s shame with the speaker’s own action.

recordSelection.title: 羞愧来自自己的行为
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: I → ashamed of laughing
rows.text: The speaker feels ashamed of laughing at his mistake.

rows.label: He → ashamed only
rows.text: Only the person who made the mistake is stated to feel ashamed.

rows.label: Praises the laughter
rows.text: The speaker approves of laughing at the mistake.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选I → ashamed of laughing；别换主体或把羞愧改成赞扬。

options.text: Only he is stated to feel ashamed of making the mistake.
options.reason: 把I的感受换成了his所指的人。

options.text: The speaker is praising the act of laughing at the mistake.
options.reason: ashamed是羞愧，不是赞扬这种行为。

options.text: The speaker felt ashamed of having laughed at his mistake.
options.reason: 感到羞愧的是I，羞愧的是自己的嘲笑行为。

items.label: sorry：忘了去归还，不是忘了还过
items.prompt: Keep the apology and what the speaker forgot to do.
items.material: I am sorry I forgot to return your ruler.
items.after: I forgot to return your ruler.
items.reason: I am sorry后接道歉的事情，that可以省略。forgot to return是忘了去归还，不是忘了已经还过。原句没有交代后来何时归还，不能擅自补写。

wordDecision.prompt: Keep the apology and what the speaker forgot to do.

recordSelection.title: 把忘记的动作写准
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: Forgot to return
rows.text: The speaker apologizes for failing to remember to return it.

rows.label: Forgot returning
rows.text: The speaker forgot the memory of an already completed return.

rows.label: Blames the listener
rows.text: The listener is blamed for not lending it.

recordSelection.hint: to return说该做却忘了做；不说明后来的归还时间。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选Forgot to return；已经还过和责怪听者都改了意思。

options.text: The sentence says the speaker forgot having already returned it.
options.reason: forgot to do不是forgot doing。

options.text: The speaker apologizes for forgetting to return the ruler.
options.reason: forgot to return是忘了去还这件事。

options.text: The listener is blamed for forgetting to lend a ruler.
options.reason: 原句I忘了归还，没有责怪you没借。

transfer.stem: Which journal notes keep the feeling, company and advice separate?
transfer.passage:
GARDEN CLUB JOURNAL
A friendly message made our new pupil Lin less lonely. It did not remove every lonely feeling. The journal does not say anyone came to sit beside Lin.
I enjoy reading alone in the garden. Reading without company does not itself tell you that I feel lonely. After a quiet walk I felt relaxed.
We were surprised by a nest’s size; no exact measurement was recorded. We are proud of our repaired garden bench, although the note does not name the person who repaired it.
When the plan changed, our teacher said, “Try to stay calm.” This was advice, not proof that everyone managed it. I felt ashamed of laughing at my friend’s mistake. I also said, “I am sorry I forgot to return your ruler.” I returned the ruler later that afternoon.

options.text: Lin felt less lonely without proof of a visitor; reading alone does not prove loneliness; the advice does not prove everyone stayed calm.
Lin could never feel lonely again; reading alone does not prove loneliness; the advice does not prove everyone stayed calm.
Lin felt less lonely without proof of a visitor; reading alone proves sadness; the advice does not prove everyone stayed calm.
Lin felt less lonely without proof of a visitor; reading alone does not prove loneliness; the advice proves everyone stayed calm.

answer.display: Lin felt less lonely without proof of a visitor; reading alone does not prove loneliness; the advice does not prove everyone stayed calm.

explanation.strategy: 先看less的程度限制，再分alone和lonely，最后分建议和实际做到。

steps.text: less lonely只说孤独感减轻；独自读书也不能直接推出孤独或难过。
steps.reason: 日记明确没有证明有人来到身边，alone说明有没有人作伴。

steps.text: Try to stay calm是建议，日记没有说每个人都成功做到。
steps.reason: advice, not proof限定结论，不能从要求跳到结果。

distractors.reason: 独处不证明难过，原文还明确说喜欢独自读书。
建议不能变成所有人已经成功保持冷静的证据。

explanation.pitfall: 把程度减轻扩大成永远消失，用人数猜感受，或把建议当成结果。

visual.title: 程度、作伴、建议

segments.text: try to stay calm ≠ already achieved

visual.caption: 感受、人数和实际结果分别核对，不靠表情推断。

explanation.transfer: 收到友好消息后孤独感减轻，能证明身边一定有人陪着吗？“尽量保持冷静”能证明已经做到吗？
